bias.zh: 偏空 · 失守 $40，逼近 52 周低点

read.en: MP Materials fell 3.0% on Oct 19 to $38.95, opening at the day's high of $40.75 and closing near the low of $38.92. It remains below all its falling averages: the 5-day ($40.6), 10-day ($43.4), 30-day ($47.3), 100-day ($52.0) and 200-day ($56.2). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($46.32), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月19日下跌 3.0%，收于 $38.95；以当日高点 $40.75 开盘，收盘接近低点 $38.92。股价仍位于全部下行均线下方：5 日（$40.6）、10 日（$43.4）、30 日（$47.3）、100 日（$52.0）和 200 日均线（$56.2）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$46.32），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The $40 round number broke on the close and turns into resistance. Resistance is $40–40.6 (round number, 5-day average), then $43.4–44.5 (10-day average, Oct 1 low) and $46.3–47.3 (SAR, 30-day average, Sep 18 low). Support is $38.6 (Oct 15 low), then $37.8 (Jul 29 52-week low) and $35. A close below $37.8 would set a new 52-week low.
read.zh: $40 整数关口于收盘失守，转为阻力。阻力为 $40–40.6（整数关口、5 日均线），其次 $43.4–44.5（10 日均线、10月1日低点）和 $46.3–47.3（SAR、30 日均线、9月18日低点）。支撑为 $38.6（10月15日低点），其次 $37.8（7月29日 52 周低点）和 $35。若收盘跌破 $37.8，将创 52 周新低。

r.zh: 抛物线SAR $46.3；30日均线及9月18日低点 $47.3
